queries: open dataset synchronized hydrogen refuelling station vehicle pressure temperature mass flow raw data H70
Zenodo hydrogen refuelling station vehicle filling dataset pressure temperature mass flow
public hydrogen fueling station experimental data vehicle tank pressure temperature time series
MetHyTrucks raw data H2 refuelling station vehicle filling dataset
search_scope.eligibility_rule: A reusable physical event must expose station/controller and dispenser/nozzle plus vehicle/receptacle channels on a common clock, with units, initial conditions, tank capacity, protocol metadata and rights sufficient for independent scoring.

sources.name: Kuroki et al., Temperature Rise on Liner Surfaces of Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Tanks during Fueling Process
sources.observed_role: NREL HITRF and Powertech fueling experiments with 36 L and 244 L Type-IV tanks; station-side pressure and inlet-temperature conditions are described.
sources.reason: The article states that research data are not shared. Figures and tabulated operating conditions are available, but no rights-cleared machine-readable synchronized station-to-vehicle logger archive was found.

sources.name: Genovese et al., Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
sources.observed_role: One-year Cal State LA HRS operating study describing back-to-back vehicle-bus fueling and station behavior.
sources.reason: The public article record describes a dataset created from operator logs, but no openly downloadable row-level synchronized station/controller/dispenser/vehicle archive or reuse licence was identified in the checked endpoint.

sources.name: NREL Hydrogen Infrastructure Testing and Research Facility
sources.observed_role: Facility page confirms automated logging of HITRF components and station-performance research.
sources.reason: The page describes data collection and research capabilities but does not publish an eligible synchronized event archive.

sources.name: Thermodynamic Modeling of Hydrogen Fueling Process from High-Pressure Storage Tank to Vehicle Tank
sources.observed_role: Published measurement locations include high-pressure storage, PCV, precooler and vehicle-tank channels.
sources.reason: The public report provides model and measurement descriptions but no rights-cleared row-level synchronized raw trace suitable for an untouched holdout.

sources.name: NREL Heavy-Duty Hydrogen Fueling Performance Demonstration
sources.observed_role: Reported 73 kg heavy-duty vehicle-simulator fill and SAE-protocol performance summaries.
sources.reason: Event-level summaries and plotted results are not a reusable synchronized raw logger archive with a complete channel dictionary and rights statement.

sources.name: MetHyTrucks public records and Hy-SaM subset
sources.observed_role: Public workbooks and a Hy-SaM subset containing station-side or sampling-system measurements.
sources.reason: The existing intake records confirm missing controller, vehicle-tank geometry and synchronized vehicle-side channel metadata; these records cannot be promoted to a station-to-vehicle holdout.

sources.name: DOE Hydrogen Infrastructure Technologies FY2024 review — heavy-duty fueling protocol test
sources.observed_role: Official program report describing a 70.5 kg heavy-duty fill in 7 minutes and SAE J2601/5 validation with preproduction hardware and wireless communications.
sources.reason: The report contains aggregate performance and protocol statements, not a rights-cleared row-level common-clock station/controller/dispenser/vehicle archive with channel definitions. It cannot close the independent full-loop gate.

sources.name: FCH2RAIL D6.1 KPI assessment
sources.observed_role: Report-level measurements for a transportable 300-bar hydrogen refuelling system, including 5/10-s flow observations and train-storage refuelling rates.
sources.reason: The report publishes ranges and operating context (11.54--19.44 g/s average flow) but no rights-cleared row-level station/controller/dispenser/vehicle common-clock archive with channel definitions.

sources.name: NLR H2FillS official release and user manual
sources.observed_role: Documented thermodynamic station-to-vehicle simulator whose output schema includes bank, PCV, hose, vehicle inlet and vehicle-tank signals.
sources.reason: The software is distributed under a registration/licence workflow and the public page/manual provide model documentation and output definitions, not an openly reusable measured synchronized event archive.

sources.name: European H2-Stations export API v2
sources.observed_role: Open station registry, layout and operational signal documentation for European hydrogen stations.
sources.reason: The API exposes availability, usage, storage and pricing signals at station level and requires a token for v2; it does not expose synchronized engineering traces for a vehicle fill or a rights-cleared transient validation cohort.

sources.name: NREL FCEV Composite Data Products
sources.observed_role: Curated FCEV fueling indicators such as final pressure and before/after tank temperature products.
sources.reason: The public catalogue lists derived indicators rather than the common-clock raw station/controller/dispenser/vehicle traces required by the frozen independent holdout contract.

primary_goal_impact.paper_limitation: Do not claim independent station-to-vehicle full-loop accuracy, vehicle-controller validation or field-safety validation from these reports, aggregate products or post-access component records.
primary_goal_impact.reentry_condition: Obtain at least three rights-cleared events with station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels on a common clock; freeze the scoring protocol before accessing outcomes.

claim_boundary: This is a public-access availability audit. It records the checked endpoints and does not prove that restricted, proprietary or unpublished traces do not exist.
